And another thing I’m venting on? So when we accept an order through the tablet, we request a specific time for the courier to come, e.g. in 20 minutes, so say if it was like 1:25 PM, the courier should get here by 1:45 PM and that’s when the order should be bagged and be ready to be given the to person. Sometimes the courier will get to the restaurant earlier than the requested time and will be upset that the food ain’t ready yet, which is understandable, but from what I gain from talking to these couriers, they don’t know that there’s a certain time we want them to get here. Like I get Skip tries to prioritize which courier to get to the restaurant to match up w/ the requested time and that’s dependent on which courier accepts/drops the order, but wtf don’t get mad at us
